name: task
description: Launch a specialized subagent synchronously and return its final output. Use this for a single focused side investigation when you need the result before continuing. For multiple parallel subagents prefer task_spawn + task_wait.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: The task/prompt to send to the subagent. Be specific about what you want accomplished.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier.

inherit.description: Optional inheritance control: 'all' (history, memory, cwd, skills), 'none' (fresh context), or a comma-separated subset of history, memory, cwd, skills. Default: cwd+skills only (history and memory kept private). Keep the default (or 'cwd') for delegated steps that touch the workspace - serial steps hand off via files. Use 'none' only for pure analysis that never touches the workspace; 'all' only when the subtask depends on the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the final output; the child must return exactly one value matching it.
